| `pai sessions end` | Finish the current session |
| `pai sessions goto` | Open a session by name or id (same as `pai open`) |
| `pai sessions handover` | Write the "Continue" block of a project's TODO.md |
| `pai sessions info` | Show everything known about one session note |
| `pai sessions list` | Named sessions with their resume status |
| `pai sessions pause` | Save a checkpoint for the current session |
| `pai sessions pause-all` | Pause every live session (needs AIBroker) |
| `pai sessions rename` | Rename a session note (file, title and registry) |
| `pai sessions route` | Link a session note to another project |
| `pai sessions slug` | Suggest a short name for a session note from its transcript |
| `pai sessions tag` | Show or set the tags of a session note |
| `pai setup` | First-time setup: storage, search, hooks, daemon, router |
| `pai setups` | Orchestrator + worker combinations (save your own) |
| `pai setups save` | Save the current combination under a name |
| `pai shell-init` | Print the shell integration code |
| `pai skill` | How your skills are used |
| `pai skill telemetry` | Which skills were used, when, and where |
| `pai task` | Cross-session task list: list, add, dispatch, done |
| `pai task add` | Add a task to the list |
| `pai task archive` | Save a task's discussion into the project notes |
| `pai task config` | Show or change task settings |
| `pai task dispatch` | Hand open tasks to the sessions that own them |
| `pai task done` | Mark a task complete |
| `pai task list` | List open tasks |
| `pai task poll` | Run one scheduler tick: dispatch what is due and report |
| `pai task projects` | Show which projects can receive tasks, and create missing ones |
| `pai task schedule` | Install, remove or check the timer that runs the scheduler |
| `pai task schedule install` | Install the timer (default: every 15 minutes) |
| `pai task schedule status` | Show whether the timer is installed and running |
| `pai task schedule uninstall` | Remove the timer |
| `pai tasks` | Same as task |
| `pai tasks add` | Add a task to the list |
| `pai tasks archive` | Save a task's discussion into the project notes |
| `pai tasks config` | Show or change task settings |
| `pai tasks dispatch` | Hand open tasks to the sessions that own them |
| `pai tasks done` | Mark a task complete |
| `pai tasks list` | List open tasks |
| `pai tasks poll` | Run one scheduler tick: dispatch what is due and report |
| `pai tasks projects` | Show which projects can receive tasks, and create missing ones |
| `pai tasks schedule` | Install, remove or check the timer that runs the scheduler |
| `pai tasks schedule install` | Install the timer (default: every 15 minutes) |
| `pai tasks schedule status` | Show whether the timer is installed and running |
| `pai tasks schedule uninstall` | Remove the timer |
| `pai tests` | Test governance: audit a repo's tests, prune them to the governed core |
| `pai tests audit` | List test files with a proposed class and the file-count trend |
| `pai tests prune` | Plan, or with --apply start a worker, that prunes the suite to the governed core |
| `pai topic` | Detect when a conversation moved to another project |
| `pai topic check` | Check whether a text belongs to a different project than the current one |
| `pai uhp` | Serve PAI workers over the Unified Harness Protocol |
| `pai uhp serve` | Serve the UHP API (discovery, harnesses, models) |
| `pai uhp token` | Manage UHP bearer tokens |
| `pai uhp token create` | Create a bearer token (shown once) |
| `pai uhp token list` | List tokens (ids and hash prefixes, never the secret) |
| `pai uhp token revoke` | Revoke a token (takes effect on the next request) |
| `pai update` | Update PAI (or another package) to the latest GitHub Release |
| `pai worker` | Run tasks on other providers: run, ps, follow, merge, providers, classes, config, ... |
| `pai worker bench` | Compare providers on a set of real tasks |
| `pai worker capability` | Choose which provider serves a capability (e.g. image) |
| `pai worker classes` | Which provider serves draft, implement, review, … |
| `pai worker classes list` | List classes and where each one runs |
| `pai worker classes set` | Send a class to a provider, or give it routing limits |
| `pai worker classes unset` | Remove a class (runs then use the active provider) |
| `pai worker config` | The workers.yaml file itself: path, init, migrate, check, inline-keys, normalize-paths |
| `pai worker config check` | Check workers.yaml for mistakes |
| `pai worker config init` | Write a commented starter workers.yaml |
| `pai worker config inline-keys` | Move key files' contents into workers.yaml |
| `pai worker config migrate` | Move or build workers.yaml from an older setup |
| `pai worker config normalize-paths` | Rewrite absolute home paths in workers.yaml as ~/… |
| `pai worker config path` | Print where workers.yaml is |
| `pai worker controls` | Hand the desktop controls to a worker, or take them back |
| `pai worker discard` | Throw away a worker's branch and worktree |
| `pai worker errors` | Tool errors workers hit, grouped by kind |
| `pai worker fallback` | Run every new Claude Code process on a worker provider |
| `pai worker flaky` | Test files that failed in the merge gate's batch and passed alone |
| `pai worker follow` | Watch a worker live, or all running workers |
| `pai worker gc` | Archive leftover worker worktrees |
| `pai worker goal` | Leave a goal note on a running worker |
| `pai worker handoff` | From inside a worker: pass a question or result to its parent |
| `pai worker help` | From inside a worker: ask a stronger model to do one sub-task (budgeted) |
| `pai worker install` | Set up the Agent hook and command shims |
| `pai worker keep` | Protect a worktree from gc |
| `pai worker kill` | Stop a running worker |
| `pai worker local` | Which local models run; the operator starts and stops them |
| `pai worker log` | Worker ledger or the raw events of one worker |
| `pai worker mcp` | MCP servers workers may load |
| `pai worker merge` | Merge a worker's branch into your checkout |
| `pai worker model` | Show or set the model a provider uses |
| `pai worker off` | Stop routing: Agent tool runs on Anthropic again |
| `pai worker on` | Send Agent-tool subagents to workers |
| `pai worker pane` | Open a window pane that follows a worker |
| `pai worker pause` | Park a worker's next engine request until resume |
| `pai worker pending` | Finished workers whose work is not merged yet |
| `pai worker policy` | Where workers run: cloud, local, or a mix |
| `pai worker pool` | Keep headless worker sessions warm between small runs |
| `pai worker priority` | Priority of a worker at the local engine, and of a session in the queue |
| `pai worker priority clear` | Remove a session's queue priority (it goes back to normal) |
| `pai worker priority list` | List the sessions with a queue priority |
| `pai worker priority set` | Give a named session a queue priority (high, normal, low) |
| `pai worker providers` | Providers workers can run on: list, add, remove, use, enable, disable, test |
| `pai worker providers add` | Add a provider (the first one also turns workers on) |
| `pai worker providers cap` | Show or set how many workers run in parallel on a provider |
| `pai worker providers disable` | Turn a provider off (automatic routing skips it) |
| `pai worker providers enable` | Turn a provider on (also clears its cooldown) |
| `pai worker providers hold` | Queue new work on a provider while running work continues |
| `pai worker providers list` | List providers, their models and whether workers are on |
| `pai worker providers release` | Lift a provider hold; queued runs start |
| `pai worker providers remove` | Remove a provider and the classes pointing at it |
| `pai worker providers test` | Check a provider answers — without a name, what workers would use now |
| `pai worker providers update` | Change a provider's cost tier and tags |
| `pai worker providers use` | Make a provider the active one |
| `pai worker proxy` | The local proxy for OpenAI-style providers |
| `pai worker ps` | List this session's workers, running and finished |
| `pai worker queue` | Show or reorder the workers waiting for a provider slot |
| `pai worker replay` | Print the transcript of one worker |
| `pai worker reroute` | Move a queued or running worker to another provider |
| `pai worker resume` | Continue a finished worker with a new instruction, or release a paused one |
| `pai worker roles` | Old name of `classes` |
| `pai worker roles list` | List classes and where each one runs |
| `pai worker roles set` | Send a class to a provider, or give it routing limits |
| `pai worker roles unset` | Remove a class (runs then use the active provider) |
| `pai worker route` | Print the routing table: per delegation tier the ordered models |
| `pai worker run` | Run one task on a worker (another provider or model) |
| `pai worker say` | Send a message to a running worker |
| `pai worker status-line` | One-line worker summary for a status bar |
| `pai worker test-run` | Run a test command; when it goes silent, say where it is stuck |
| `pai worker usage` | Token totals per provider and model for a set of workers |
| `pai worker verify` | Check that a worker's changes are already in your checkout |
| `pai worker wait` | Wait for child workers; returns when any finishes or --max elapses |
| `pai worker wait-file` | Wait for files to appear |
| `pai worker wait-on` | Wait for a background job to finish |
| `pai worker wait-url` | Wait for a server to answer HTTP |
| `pai worker watch` | Worker list that refreshes every 2 seconds |
| `pai zettel` | Explore the links between your notes |
| `pai zettel converse` | Ask the vault a question |
| `pai zettel explore` | Follow link chains from a note |
| `pai zettel health` | Check the vault for dead links and orphans |
| `pai zettel suggest` | Suggest new links for a note |
| `pai zettel surprise` | Find notes that are alike in meaning but far apart in links |
| `pai zettel themes` | Spot topics emerging in recent notes |
